The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an insect, able to be found by foraging flowers during the night, after unlocking [[Farming and Nature (Tech Tree)|Insects]] under the given tech tree. It can be decomposed into reagents for use in [[alchemy]], or used as a bait for [[fishing]].

==Alchemy ==
{{PAGENAME}}s can be decomposed into either a [[Chaos solution|solution]] or [[Chaos extract|extract]] with the [[hand mixer]] and either of the distillation cubes, respectively. Once you've u unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|the Master of Alchemy]] it produces one additional reagent at any workstation.

==Fishing==
{{PAGENAME}}s can also be utilized while [[fishing]], as one of eight(8) available baits to choose from.
*There are five(5) susceptible fish; the [[Frog]], [[Tilapia]], [[Perch]], [[Carp]], and [[Sturgeon]].
*The [[Butterfly]] is practically identical to the {{PAGENAME}} in this regard.
*Aside from the Frog and Sturgeon, these fish are also tempted by the third insect bait, the [[maggot]].
*A {{PAGENAME}} (or Butterfly) is required in order to catch a Frog.
*The Sturgeon is generally considered the best commodity, given a {{PAGENAME}} bait.
